blind.B1: The paper (salbutamol x unilateral hindlimb immobilization, mouse and human) has no exercise arm. Disuse (immobilization) is the only activity-related factor. Quadriceps RNA-seq (GSE278016, DA.p1) is the mouse study only. Sequenced samples: 75 = 5 groups x 15 (H.0.0.R, CR.0.0.L, CR.I.0.R, CR.0.S.L, CR.I.S.R).
blind.B2: S3.6.p1-p2: immobilization (CR+I vs CR untreated; 2241 genes), caloric restriction (CR vs healthy; 6513), salbutamol in the mobile leg (2904; 2106 overlap with CR), salbutamol in the immobilized leg (518 of 2904 still significant). n=15 per group.
blind.B3: Yes. S2.7.p1: CR mice are immobilized on the right leg only, so the left (mobile) and right (immobilized) quadriceps of one CR mouse are both sequenced. No mouse column in GEO. Sample numbers in title/description differ by exactly +60 between legs (016-030 -> 076-090, 031-045 -> 091-105; healthy 061-075 = mouse 1-15 + 60). This is a candidate key, undocumented.
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether one model or pairwise fits were used. It says only that the counts were the input for DESeq2 (S2.11.p1).
blind.B5: No gene-level rule is stated. S2.11.p1 gives only the GSEA/Reactome rule 'p values < 0.01'. S2.13.p1 uses p < 0.05 for other outcomes. Reported counts: 2241, 6513, 2904, 518, 281.

checks.evidence: Packet B study.caveats and HANDBACK say 'No exercise arm'; immobilization is labelled as disuse, route declared_deviation.

grp levels H/CR/CRS/CRI/CRIS = 15 each, matches S2.7 and the GEO treatment code. Direction of each contrast is correct. CR vs H compares CR left legs with H right legs, so leg side is aliased with the group there. The confounding table records the crosstab but the CR vs H caveat is not worded.
control/treatment: CR->CRI, H->CR, CR->CRS, CRI->CRIS. Rac1 log2FC -0.263 matches S4.p3.

covariance reasoning: 'no mouse ID exists in metadata, so the pairing cannot be recovered without guessing'. Only the sample-number ranges were looked at. The data show a constant offset of +60 (sample number of the right leg - 60 = left-leg number) that links all 30 CR left/right pairs once each and fits the healthy mice as 1-15. S2.7.p1 says both legs of CR mice are sequenced. Packet A's keys did not search numeric offsets. Unpaired fit is statistically valid but conservative; the primary contrast CRI vs CR and CRIS vs CRS are within-mouse.
checks.fix: Add a sensitivity execution: mouse = (description number) for left legs and (number - 60) for right legs, design ~ mouse + cell (or paired contrasts on CR/CRI and CRS/CRIS), labelled as an assumption. Run tools/pairing_check.py first: same-mouse pairs should correlate more than random left/right pairs. Report it next to the unpaired primary and ask the authors/GEO submitter to confirm.

checks.evidence: Paper silent (B4). CRI vs CR 2152 vs 2241 and CRS vs CR 2712 vs 2904 are close, but CR vs H 8309 vs 6513 (+28%). Only the joint fit was run.
checks.fix: Optionally also report pairwise fits for CR vs H.

checks.evidence: covariance.confounding lists leg side nested in group, and the caveat 'Immobilized leg is always the right leg' is in study.caveats. No batch/sequencing-run info in metadata.
Raw HTSeq counts, integer_fraction 1.0; DESeq2 (pydeseq2) matches paper's DESeq2. frac_p_gt_0.9 about 0.25, no pile-up near 1.
Paper states no gene rule; applied padj<0.05 recorded as workflow_default with raw p<0.05 audit. Packet B table shows no alternative rule fitting the paper's numbers (all differ).
Counts compared contrast-for-contrast (S3.6.p1-p2). HANDBACK states the paper has no stated rule and does not claim agreement for CR vs H (8309 vs 6513).
Case ran to completion; no stop. The 'no mouse key' claim is handled under pairing.

human_items: Policy: whether a disuse (immobilization) contrast with no exercise arm counts as an exercise study (open policy question).
Whether to accept the +60 sample-number offset as the mouse key without confirmation from the authors.
summary: 本案无运动组，以固定（废用）对侧腿对照作为活动对比，已声明为 declared_deviation，分组、方向、矩阵、阈值均无问题。主要问题：同一只CR小鼠的左右腿都被测序，而分析声称无法恢复配对；实际样本编号相差恒为60，可一一配对，应作为带标注假设的敏感性分析补跑（含 pairing_check）。
